questiontext.text: What is the main purpose of list comprehensions in Haskell?

answer.text: To construct new lists from existing lists

feedback.text: Correct. List comprehensions provide a concise way to build new lists from existing ones.
Incorrect. Data types are defined using data declarations, not list comprehensions.
Incorrect. IO operations are handled using the IO monad.
Incorrect. Recursion can be used with lists, but list comprehensions themselves do not define recursion.
